research_question: RQ21: does an artifact-validity instrument, scored separately from a learning-outcome instrument, predict whether a production earns real fusion weight?

claims.text: An early draft treated a student's own repeated self-citation across prior productions as if it alone raised this address's fusion weight, before an independent artifact-validity check caught the confound and the claim was withdrawn.
